lessons.title: Finance basics
lessons.teaser: What finance really is, saving vs. investing, budgeting, compound interest, inflation, risk and return.

lessons.title: Stock market basics
lessons.teaser: What a stock is, how the TSX and Wall Street work, indexes, ETFs, dividends, bull and bear markets, diversification.

lessons.title: How to start investing in Canada
lessons.teaser: TFSA, RRSP, FHSA and RESP explained, choosing a broker, buying your first ETF in 5 steps, mistakes and scams to avoid.

levels.name: Beginner
levels.learn: How money really works, how the stock market moves, how to read a company, and how to build a portfolio — value, growth, momentum and diversification.
levels.capstoneDetail: A simulated $1,000,000 portfolio on a virtual stock exchange — one strategy, defined and defended in front of the class.

levels.name: Intermediate
levels.learn: The economy and the markets, bonds, ETFs and asset allocation, measuring risk, valuation (DCF), moats, market history and factor investing.
levels.capstoneDetail: Run a $1,000,000 multi-asset portfolio with a written investment policy, a benchmark and a risk scorecard — and present it to an investment committee.

levels.name: Advanced
levels.course: Advanced Investment Management: How the Pros Invest
levels.learn: How Wall Street works, options and futures, rates and currencies, quantitative investing, hedge funds, private markets, risk management and AI.
levels.capstoneDetail: Design a professional strategy, run it on $1,000,000 with written risk limits and a trading journal — then pitch it to a mock investment committee.
